page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.32xlarge is a high-density compute-optimized instance built on KVM virtualization. Powered by AMD EPYC 7T83 processors running at a clock frequency of 2.55 GHz, this x86_64 server provides 128 dedicated vCPUs alongside 256 GiB of system memory. This configuration yields a compute-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GiB per vCPU. The instance incorporates a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps and operates without integrated local storage or dedicated hardware accelerators.

The dedicated CPU core allocation ensures consistent compute execution without resource contention from shared-tenant burst activity. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM balance prioritizes high-throughput processing over memory-heavy caching. Because local disk storage is omitted, all data persistence relies on remote block storage, introducing a dependency on network-attached storage architectures. From a resource efficiency standpoint, the high vCPU count delivers high compute density in a single footprint, maximizing resource utilization for workloads capable of parallel execution across 128 cores without requiring large memory allocations per thread.

Given its core count and 32 Gbps network interface, the ecs.c7a.32xlarge instance is suited for compute-heavy parallel workloads. Key deployment scenarios include batch processing, distributed data processing, scientific simulations, continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, and high-concurrency web serving environments.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.32xlarge is a compute-optimized instance engineered for intensive parallel execution. Built on the x86_64 architecture with KVM virtualization, it features 128 dedicated vCPUs powered by AMD EPYC 7T83 processors operating at 2.55 GHz. The system provides 256 GiB of memory, establishing a 2.0 GiB per vCPU ratio optimal for compute-focused tasks. Network throughput is backed by a 32 Gbps baseline interface. The instance does not include local disk storage or GPU acceleration, requiring reliance on external network storage solutions for data persistence. This hardware allocation profile provides dense parallel processing capacity while avoiding the higher costs associated with excess memory per core. The ecs.c7a.32xlarge instance is suited for heavy batch processing, continuous integration build clusters, distributed web application servers, and scientific simulation workloads requiring substantial CPU throughput.
